search_window.basis: Nominal prior hourly check time to this watch completion; precise prior execution completion could not be independently established from available ledger listing; dates and source publication times evaluated for freshness.

coverage_notes: Supplementary bounded recall watch; production nationwide Food Line collection remains authoritative.

12 targeted web searches completed without search errors, scoped to four high-value audit miss classes: sole/last/full-service grocery losses (3); storm, flood, fire or outage-canceled emergency distributions (3); abrupt food-pantry/food-bank service closure or major reduction (3); new official SNAP, WIC, or EBT interruptions with immediate food-access impact (3).

Targeted queries used explicit October 24-25, 2026 dates, site:gov filters for official benefits notices, and incident terminology. Results were checked for U.S. relevance, direct impact, freshness and novelty.

No qualifying new signal verified in the approximately one-hour observation window. Returned results predominantly concerned prior months/years or routine services, fundraising, general coverage, and other excluded topics.
Eastport, Maine's sole-store closure report predates this watch by about a month and was excluded as not new (https://wgme.com/news/local/eastports-only-grocery-store-to-close-rm-iga-maine-food).

A Kauai hurricane-recovery update dated October 23 contained no verified new cancellation of emergency food distribution within this window (https://kauainownews.com/2026/10/23/what-kaua%CA%BBi-county-residents-visitors-need-to-know-thursday-about-hurricane-lowell-recovery/).
The earlier October 24 pantry closure leads recorded by previous checks remain outside the new-signal threshold; none of the fresh search results supplied a qualifying new verified development.
No approval, publication, schedule change, automation disablement, or production collection change occurred.
